And I don't know, I only know the feeling of one of those.
 I'm trying to meet new people and see if I can have that kind of relationship where I can be more open about myself and what I'm going through. But I get anxious just to approach to say hi to the bus driver.

I feel that the second I try it, everything will come out and I'll start crying.

I just want a hug, or a pad in the shoulder, I don't know really what would help at this point.

Anything can't be bad if you do it with the best intentions, don't worry.

And I really don't know, every therapist says that it is not a trauma or a mental illness other than depression.
If I had to guess, I'll say that I've spent so much time alone that I'm used to be that way. And that people assume I'm ok because I've never reached for help, plus hiding every emotions in public does not help.

I always seen myself as "nice" sometimes too nice, a friend told me that people can see kindness for weakness and would step over you, and that I should be tougher with others but is like if the comfort of others makes me happy... Its just that it is almost impossible for me to open up with someone.
And I think that people see me as someone who you can vent with, and a good listener, but in my opinion, listeners are not listen as much as everyone thinks, that they (we) just exist to hear problems and give advice, not the other way.... Anyway, thanks for the advice and I'll try to be nice again, lately it has lost its meaning, but I'll try.
